# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-lanmode
LAN Access, mDNS (dsh.local), PWA, Root CA, Quick QR, Notifications & Auto-TLS for DeepSeek Harness

🇬🇧 English •
🇷🇺 Русский •
🇨🇳 中文说明
## ⚡ Overview & Features
`dsh-lanmode` brings seamless and secure local network (LAN) and WAN remote access to DeepSeek Harne
h-lanmode` brings seamless and secure local network (LAN) and WAN remote access to DeepSeek Harness:
1. **📱 Quick QR Popover**: Tap the smartphone icon in the sidebar footer (`Quick QR` in `sidebar.foo
ter` / `sidebar.rail`) to open an interactive SVG QR code. Supports the `/mobileqr` chat tool and AS

CII QR output.
2. **📲 PWA & Standalone Mode**: Serves `/dsh-lanmode/manifest.json` with `viewport-fi

t=cover` for full-screen mobile experience.
3. **🌐 Automatic mDNS (`dsh.local`)**: Built-in UDP 5353

responder announces `dsh.local` across the LAN automatically.
4. **🔐 Local Root CA & HTTPS**: Gener
ates a 10-year Root CA and trusted SAN certificates (`dsh.local`, LAN IP, localhost). One-click down

load via `/dsh-lanmode/ca.crt`.
5. **🔔 Background Web Push & Notifications API**: Delivers system pu

sh notifications on agent turn end and approval requests.
6. **🛡️ Comprehensive Security & Authentic

ation**:
- Authentication passwords support plaintext and scrypt key derivation. Verified in constan

t time via `timingSafeEqual`.
- LAN PIN protection with plaintext or `PBKDF2` stretching (`pbkdf2$sh

a512$100000$salt$hash`). Auto-lockout for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failures.
- Device and sess

ion tokens stored exclusively as salted `SHA-256` digests.
- Subnet role separation (`adminAllow` an

d `guestAllow`). Guest subnets cannot mutate settings or revoke sessions.
7. **☁️ Cloudflare WAN Tun

nels & Tailscale Funnel**:
- Supports zero-config `Quick Tunnels` (trycloudflare.com) and persistent

`Named Tunnels` via token (passed securely via `TUNNEL_TOKEN` env, hidden from `ps aux`).
- The `tu

nnelPin` option enforces LAN PIN verification for all requests arriving over WAN tunnels.
- 1-click
`Tailscale Funnel` integration providing public HTTPS with automated trusted Let's Encrypt certifica

tes.
8. **📱 Device Registry & Session Revocation**: Track connected devices and revoke active sessio
ns individually or all-at-once.
